_comment: One entry per environment variable the code or compose file reads. The generator fails when a variable is used but not described here or in .env.example.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Password of the bundled PostgreSQL database. Use URL-safe letters and digits: it is placed inside DATABASE_URL.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 64 hex characters (`openssl rand -hex 32`). Encrypts two-factor secrets, stored S3 credentials, SMTP passwords and plugin secrets. Keep it permanently; replacing it makes them unreadable.

WEB_ORIGIN.description: The exact origin browsers use for the panel. Used for CORS, the Origin check on cookie requests, WebSocket checks and passkeys.

NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.description: Browser-reachable API origin. Empty means the panel's host on port 4000. Compiled into the panel image: rebuild after changing.

NEXT_PUBLIC_GITHUB_REPOSITORY.description: Repository the panel links to for releases (build-time).

GITHUB_REPOSITORY.description: `owner/name` of the GitHub repository the update checker reads releases from.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional fine-grained token with read-only Contents/Metadata access, for private release checks.

APP_VERSION.description: The version the panel reports; set by the release you checked out.

API_BIND.description: Host interface the API port (4000) is published on.

WEB_BIND.description: Host interface the panel port (3000) is published on.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Behind a reverse proxy: the number of proxy hops (usually `1`), or a comma-separated list of proxy addresses or ranges. `true` trusts every hop. Unset when the API is exposed directly.

ADMIN_IP_ALLOW_DISABLE.description: Break-glass: set `true` to ignore the administrator network allow-list if you locked yourself out.

S3_BUCKET.description: Seeds the object storage form before the first save.

S3_ACCESS_KEY.description: Seeds the object storage form (also used by the bundled SeaweedFS service).

S3_SECRET_KEY.description: Seeds the object storage form (also used by the bundled SeaweedFS service).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Path-style S3 endpoint. Must be reachable from the API, every node and browsers.

ALLOWED_IMAGE_PREFIXES.description: Comma-separated Docker image prefixes templates may use. Seeds the setting in the panel.

PLUGIN_REGISTRY_URL.description: HTTPS address of the plugin registry index. Empty turns the registry off; bundled plugins always work.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server for invitations, password reset and email notifications.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password (stored encrypted once saved in the panel).

WEBAUTHN_RP_ID.description: Passkey relying-party id. Defaults to the host of WEB_ORIGIN; set only for unusual setups.

WEBAUTHN_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated extra origins allowed for passkeys.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Compose builds it from POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

HOST.description: Interface the API listens on inside its container.

NODE_ENV.description: `production` makes cookies `Secure`; set by the Compose file.

TRANSFER_DIR.description: Spool directory for file transfers when object storage is off.

UPDATER_URL.description: Address of the updater service; set by Compose.

UPDATE_TOKEN_FILE.description: Shared token file between the API and the updater.

PLUGIN_HOST_URL.description: Address of the plugin host (`http://plugins:4020`); set by Compose. Empty disables plugins.

PLUGIN_TOKEN_FILE.description: Shared bearer token file between the API and the plugin host.

BUNDLED_PLUGINS_DIR.description: Where the bundled plugins are read from; defaults to the copy inside the image.

FLEDGE_TEST_ALLOW_LOCAL_FETCH.description: Tests only: lets notification webhooks and plugin registry fetches use local HTTP addresses. Never set in production.

PLUGIN_HOST_NO_LISTEN.description: Tests only: import the plugin host without listening.

PLUGIN_HOST_UNSAFE_TEST_ALLOW_LOCAL.description: Tests only: lets the plugin host reach local HTTP. Never set in production.

PLUGIN_HOST_UNSAFE_TEST_HOST_MAP.description: Tests only: map host names to local test servers.

RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_WRITE.description: Tests only: raises the authentication write rate limit.

SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS.description: Tests only: how often the API's background sweep runs (default 15000).

SLOW_SWEEP_MS.description: Tests only: interval of the slower sweep (default 60000).

INSTALL_PLUGIN_WAIT_ATTEMPTS.description: Tests only: how many times install.sh checks the plugin host.

UPDATE_POLL_SECONDS.description: Tests only: polling interval of the update scripts.

ENROLLMENT_TOKEN.description: One-time token; cleared from the process after reading.

CREDENTIAL_FILE.description: Where the node credential is stored (mode 0600).

SFTP_HOST_KEY.description: Path of the SFTP host key. Defaults to `sftp_host_key` beside the credential file.

ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.description: `true` allows an HTTP panel URL; local evaluation only.

FLEDGE_DOCKER_TEST_IMAGE.description: Agent tests only: an image already on the local engine for the live stdin test.
